ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.quote: The fight at our Outer Tower was taken four against five after Drongo's death, and Greystone, who was alive and ahead in his own lane, never joined to even the numbers. The fight went our way anyway, but the numbers were against us walking in.

ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.rewrite: Drongo died before we fought for our Outer Tower, and we still won that fight, but they took the tower anyway in the same window.

Worth testing the recommended core next time to see if that damage gap closes.

ea696257-4943-4784-805b-dedb3e74b1fa.rewrite: Weald's low-health execute projectiles reward finishing off targets at range, which suits a kiting marksman like Drongo.
